assumptions: All times in Asia/Kolkata. 10 destination stay days means 9 hotel nights. Arrival and checkout are included in stay days; overnight travel adds separate calendar dates (10 dates door to door).
Editable demonstration timings, fictional hotels and estimated INR rates; verify all operational details before travel.
Intercity fares excluded; arrange separately. Taxes excluded and not calculated.
Private day rates include driver, fuel, gateway transfers and relocations; independent travel uses an allowance, with relocation charged separately.
All travellers, including infants, occupy one vehicle seat and count toward room occupancy. Every room requires an adult.
Hotel nights follow actual overnight dates. No guaranteed early check-in. Luggage drop and waiting/rest are assumed available.
Meals while travelling or overlapping transfers are self-arranged and excluded. Hotel breakfast is deducted only where included.
Conditional adventures require weather, access and operator confirmation. No live availability check.
Unscheduled or fallback activities are not charged; fallback suggestions require regeneration with a revised choice.
Private vehicle overages use elapsed touring time and stored kilometres, including waiting during visits.
